qualification.details: Medical Superintendent: Medical qualification included in I or II Schedule or Part II of third Schedule to Indian Medical Council Act 1956 with PG degree (M.D./M.S./M.H.A. or equivalent) and 10 years experience in Hospital Administration in hospitals after obtaining PG Degree preferably in hospitals with 300 beds. Registrar: Graduate from recognized University with 7 years experience of administration in supervisory capacity or as teacher in University/Teaching institution; Desirable: Postgraduate Degree. Executive Engineer (Civil): Holding analogous post OR Assistant Engineer (Civil) with 5 years regular service in GP Rs. 5400 OR Junior Engineer (Civil) with 7 years regular service in GP Rs. 4600. Executive Engineer (Electrical): Holding analogous post OR Assistant Engineer (Electrical) with 5 years regular service in GP Rs. 5400 OR Junior Engineer (Electrical) with 7 years regular service in GP Rs. 4600. Senior Accounts Officer: Holding analogous post OR 5 years regular service in relevant field in GP Rs. 5400. Assistant Administrative Officer: Holding analogous post OR 5 years regular service in GP Rs. 4200 in relevant field with Degree from recognized University; Desirable: MBA/PG Diploma in Management, Knowledge of Govt Rules, Proficiency in Computers. Assistant Account Officer: Holding analogous post OR Junior Accounts Officer with 5 years regular service in GP Rs. 4200. Office Superintendent: Holding analogous post OR 10 years regular service in GP Rs. 2400 in relevant field. Upper Division Clerk: Holding analogous post OR 8 years regular service in GP Rs. 1900 with Degree from recognized University, Proficiency in computers and skill test norm as LDC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://aiimsgorakhpur.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21 September 2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 21 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies are available for various posts in the AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026. These positions are being filled through deputation.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment drive is 56 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the starting date for the application process?
faq.answer: The application process for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026 started on 22 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Gorakhpur (AIIMS Gorakhpur).

faq.answer: Eligibility criteria vary by post, but generally include specific medical or graduate qualifications with relevant experience in administration, engineering, or accounts, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 will involve Document Verification and an Interview.
